description: 01:00 - 01:30: Tagged cement at 2768m w/ 10t, released spear by rotating 2x turns clockwise and observed torque dropped to 6knm then increased to 9knm. Observed hook load dropped to 90t. RIH slowly and located top of 7in tubing 7m lower or at 2775m. Set down 10t to repeat tagging of the cement
